items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I met him in Chicago. Slim and I were playing in Chicago at that time, and that's when I met Jimmy Blanton with Duke Ellington.

ctx.x: Do you remember whose recordings you listened to?

Yeah. Duke Ellington especially. And I remember first time that I saw Duke Ellington and his band in person, my folks took me over to the Apollo Theater at 125th Street in New York to see him. He was appearing there.
How old were you then, about?
